SPEC-001.rationale: As-built platform baseline; no verdict-bearing study claim.

SPEC-002.rationale: Platform/methods implementation; no Indus verdict produced.

SPEC-003.rationale: Platform update + traceability; no Indus verdict produced.

SPEC-004.rationale: Executable package of the Phase-52 SA run; SA-basis outputs' evidentiary status was superseded program-wide by Phase-107 + H26. No rerun on the SA basis can cure that.

SPEC-005.rationale: Design executed as Phase-107: held-out validation with discriminating blind controls (Sanskrit/scrambled statistically identical to target). Framework satisfied on its record; see PHASE-107.

SPEC-006.rationale: Anchor provenance audit (Phase-108): deterministic record work, no statistical verdict.

SPEC-007.rationale: Phase-109 remediation executed under the H26 non-SA evidence gate; adjudication record, not a statistical test.

SPEC-008.rationale: Phase-110 dossier adjudication on non-SA evidence; no statistical verdict.

SPEC-009.rationale: Executed as Phase-111: INVALID RUN — control validity failed. Tie-break 1: no rerun of the same design cures an invalid instrument basis; taxonomy reading INVALID stands via assessment.

SPEC-010.rationale: Executed as Phase-112: INVALID RUN — control validity failed. Same basis as SPEC-009.

SPEC-011.rationale: Executed as Phase-113 (non-SA44 battery): rejected at calibration; no valid confirmation test completed, so the framework reading is INCONCLUSIVE, not a contradiction of the 44 anchors' claims.

SPEC-012.rationale: Executed as Phases 113/114 (blind affiliation, adversarial): INVALID RUN — the grammar-free generator control was non-discriminating (won 100% of draws in the recorded round). Instrument-basis defect; reinterpret only.

SPEC-013.rationale: Feasibility study completed; descriptive crosswalk groundwork, no verdict.

SPEC-014.rationale: Executed as Phase-115: BATTERY REJECTED at calibration. Framework reading INCONCLUSIVE for the tested claims.

SPEC-015.rationale: Executed as Phase-116: verdicts (H-MAPPING, H-DEFINITION refuted) rest on recorded effect estimates from recorded datasets; deterministic recomputation suffices. Replay in Phase-386 spot set.

SPEC-016.rationale: Executed as Phase-117: BATTERY REJECTED at calibration. Framework reading INCONCLUSIVE.

SPEC-017.rationale: Executed as Phase-118: BATTERY REJECTED at calibration; the spec's own S10 named the coarse-fabric limit. Framework reading INCONCLUSIVE.

SPEC-018.rationale: PRED-2026 readiness harness (Phase-119). Criteria tie-break 3 caps PRED items at reproduce/reinterpret; the harness is deterministic and its refusal behavior is the result.

SPEC-019.rationale: Executed as Phase-125 (+127 diagnostic): the falsifier pattern was pre-declared in the spec (S6.3) and Phase-127 already computed the bootstrap interval for the effect. Replay (Phase-386) + taxonomy adjudication in the assessment; no C1-C4 correction remains unapplied.

SPEC-020.rationale: Adjudication paper: the Soviet dataset does not qualify as a PRED test — a classification decision on recorded criteria, not a statistical verdict.

SPEC-021.rationale: Executed as Phase-127: deterministic diagnostic (null replicates + bootstrap) over recorded Phase-125 outputs; replay in Phase-386.

SPEC-021-INTAKE.rationale: Phase-130 intake pack: tooling with validator + tests on record; no verdict.

SPEC-022.rationale: Executed as Phase-131: attribution percentages are deterministic functions of recorded datasets; replay in Phase-386 spot set.

SPEC-023.rationale: Executed as Phase-132 (keyed-transcription pilot). C4: complete on-disk coding records exist; rescoring under the taxonomy + interval completion is specified in the Phase-383 rerun contract.

SPEC-024.rationale: Stage 1 pilots (Phases 134/135) meet C4; Stage 2 arms F2/F3 (Phase-137) meet C1 (chi-square p-values with point V only; intervals computable from the recorded layer).

SPEC-025.rationale: Phase-140 (G1) meets C1: SUPPORTED rested on the permutation p-value with a point Cramer's V; a stratified interval for V is computable from the recorded layer under the frozen strata.

PHASE-105.rationale: Name-sign tests: small-n, labels inconclusive/challenged on their own record; no rerun cures the power basis.

PHASE-106.rationale: Release-integrity / audit workstream phase; deterministic checks on record, no statistical verdict.

PHASE-107.rationale: Framework exemplar: strengthened SA run with held-out recovery 0.000 and discriminating negative controls (Sanskrit, scrambled) statistically identical to the target condition. Falsification stands as recorded.

PHASE-108.rationale: Anchor provenance audit; deterministic record work.

PHASE-109.rationale: Remediation under the H26 non-SA evidence gate (KEEP 1 / RESTORE 112 / DEMOTE 3); adjudication, not a test.

PHASE-110.rationale: M222 dossier adjudication; premise superseded on non-SA evidence.

PHASE-111.rationale: INVALID RUN — CONTROL VALIDITY FAILED (own record). Tie-break 1.

PHASE-112.rationale: INVALID RUN — CONTROL VALIDITY FAILED (own record). Tie-break 1.

PHASE-113.rationale: Two studies share this number: the Spec 011 non-SA44 battery (rejected at calibration -> INCONCLUSIVE) and the Spec 012 blind-affiliation run (INVALID). Neither is rerunnable on its original basis.

PHASE-114.rationale: Blind affiliation round: the grammar-free generator won 100% of draws — a non-discriminating instrument by the run's own record; INVALID. No standalone report in scoped locations (record defect noted in the assessment).

PHASE-115.rationale: BATTERY REJECTED at calibration (frozen gates). No valid confirmation test completed; framework reading INCONCLUSIVE.

PHASE-116.rationale: Refutations rest on recorded effect estimates (median W1, rho, identical-text pairs) from recorded datasets; deterministic recomputation suffices; spot replay in Phase-386.

PHASE-117.rationale: BATTERY REJECTED at calibration. Framework reading INCONCLUSIVE.

PHASE-118.rationale: BATTERY REJECTED at calibration (14/67 positives vs the frozen >=0.5 gate). Framework reading INCONCLUSIVE; the spec's coarse-fabric limit stands as the recorded explanation, not as a claim contradiction.

PHASE-119.rationale: PRED readiness harness; tie-break 3 caps at reproduce. Deterministic refusal behavior is the result.

PHASE-120.rationale: Descriptive triage of the 44 pending anchors against Bhaskar (2024), with a recorded null simulation for one sign; no verdict.

PHASE-121.rationale: Dataset extraction memo; 36/36 hand-verified at build; data observation.

PHASE-122.rationale: Crosswalk v1 + mayig intake: pair counts are verdict-bearing downstream; deterministic rebuild from recorded sources; committed tests exist (family pattern).

PHASE-123.rationale: Wells segmentation witness memo; descriptive counts (SAME/SPLIT/MERGE) on record, no verdict.

PHASE-124.rationale: CISI image-layer catalogue: enabling asset with recorded sample accuracy (98.9%); counts are descriptive and provenance-sound on their record.

PHASE-125.rationale: FAIL — DISAGREEMENT under a pre-declared falsifier (Spec 019 S6.3); Phase-127 already supplied the effect interval. Replay in Phase-386; taxonomy adjudication (CONTRADICTED for the bounded agreement claim) in the assessment.

PHASE-126.rationale: Descriptive Wells-split analysis of the CANDIDATE cohort; no verdict.

PHASE-127.rationale: Deterministic diagnostic over Phase-125 outputs (999-replicate null + bootstrap); replay in Phase-386.

PHASE-128.rationale: Evidence dossiers for the 44 pending anchors; descriptive synthesis, no verdict.

PHASE-129.rationale: Cropper v2 benchmark on a frozen sample; descriptive engineering result.

PHASE-130.rationale: Intake pack tooling; schema/validator on record with tests.

PHASE-131.rationale: Attribution percentages are deterministic functions of recorded datasets (6.1% attributed / 93.9% residual); spot replay in Phase-386.

PHASE-132.rationale: Stage P pilot: verdict-bearing agreement scores (exact-sequence 0.20) computed from complete on-disk coding records. C4 rescoring under the taxonomy + bootstrap intervals + coder origin-group audit (all passes share one model origin — independence note the original report disclosed but did not propagate into the verdict).

PHASE-133.rationale: Stage 0 coverage audit: counts are deterministic from recorded layers and were verdict-bearing for the Stage 1 design; deterministic recomputation suffices.

PHASE-134.rationale: Motif pilot 1: agreement 0.84 / kappa 0.7885 point estimates from complete on-disk records; the middle-band call turned on one object. C4 rescoring + bootstrap intervals under the taxonomy.

PHASE-135.rationale: Motif re-pilot: agreement 0.78 / kappa 0.7129 point estimates from complete on-disk records. C4 rescoring + bootstrap intervals under the taxonomy.

PHASE-136.rationale: F1: effect estimate with interval reported at origin (MH OR 2.384, 95% CI 1.847-3.077; CMH), and the LOSO robustness check the framework would ask for was completed in Phase-141. Framework satisfied.

PHASE-137.rationale: F2 + F3: chi-square permutation verdicts with point Cramer's V only (0.1154 / 0.2190); no interval, no practical margin adjudicated. C1: bootstrap intervals for V are computable from the recorded layer under the original permutation design.

PHASE-138.rationale: Graffiti arm executed as DESCRIPTIVE ONLY by frozen design; no verdict claimed or possible.

PHASE-139.rationale: Covariate audit: margins-only by frozen design, eligibility gate applied verbatim, NOT ESTIMABLE outcome pre-designed. Framework exemplar.

PHASE-140.rationale: G1 SUPPORTED under control rested on the permutation p-value (0/9,999) with point V 0.2190; no interval for the controlled effect. C1: stratified bootstrap interval for V computable from the recorded layer under the frozen composition x preservation strata. Chronology rider is unaffected and carries into the rerun report verbatim.

PHASE-141.rationale: LOSO sensitivity: per-subset ORs with 95% CIs against a pre-set robustness criterion; no verdicts minted by design. Framework satisfied.
